name: audara-studio
description: Make videos from code: a deterministic WebGL/GLSL, three.js and Canvas2D engine with a live browser preview you direct by time and an offline render to MP4, plus a soundtrack skill that turns a song or a script into audio and timing data, a video-ideas skill that helps choose what to make and writes the starting prompt, a video-repo skill that puts a project in git for someone else to clone and render, a youtube-package skill that makes a finished video's thumbnails, title, description and tags, and a nutlight-style skill, a house style for explainers (squirrel characters in luminous geometric worlds) that loads when it is named.

interface.shortDescription: Videos from code, directed in a live preview
interface.longDescription: Direct a video made from code: GLSL, three.js and Canvas2D scenes driven by time, a live browser preview you give notes on by time, and a deterministic headless-Chrome to ffmpeg render. The soundtrack skill turns a song or a script into audio files plus beat and word timings, video-ideas helps decide what to make before building it, video-repo puts the project in git so someone else can clone it and render it again, youtube-package makes three thumbnail options with one title, the description with chapters and the tags for publishing, and nutlight-style directs a named house style: squirrels acting out ideas in luminous geometric worlds, with music from your own library.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second video for song.mp3, dark and engraved
Turn this script into a narrated 20-second explainer
Give me three ideas for a short video about my bakery
